title: Booleanization is a section on $\{0,1\}$
statement: Let $p$ be a prime and let $a \in \mathbb{Z}/p$ satisfy $a \in \{0, 1\}$. Write $\beta(a) \in \mathrm{Fin}\,2$ for the booleanization of $a$, equal to $1$ when $a = 1$ and to $0$ otherwise. Then interpreting $\beta(a)$ as a natural number and reducing it back modulo $p$ recovers $a$; that is, the image of $\beta(a)$ under $\mathrm{Fin}\,2 \to \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}/p$ equals $a$.
replaced:
If $a \in \{0,1\} \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/p$, then casting $\texttt{ACP.bitify}\,(a)$ back into
$\mathbb{Z}/p$ through $\mathbb{N}$ recovers $a$.
